conditions.name: 紧张性头痛
conditions.summary: Tension headache is a dull, band-like pain across the forehead or base of the skull; classical acupressure points include LI4, GB20, and LV3.

conditions.name: 心绪不安
conditions.summary: For mild anxiety, classical acupressure reaches for points like HT7, PC6, and Yintang — typically alongside slow breathing.

conditions.name: 旅途恶心
conditions.summary: PC6 (Neiguan) on the inner forearm is the classical acupoint for travel and morning nausea and the point behind motion-sickness wristbands.

conditions.name: 失眠
conditions.summary: For sleep, classical acupressure pairs a calming point at the wrist, HT7, with a grounding point on the sole, KI1.

conditions.name: 经痛
conditions.summary: For period pain, TCM most often draws on SP6, LV3, and local abdominal points — though some (like SP6) are avoided during pregnancy.

conditions.name: 腰背痛
conditions.summary: Classical acupressure for lower back pain often combines BL23, BL40, and GB30, chosen by where the pain is located.

conditions.name: 伏案颈肩痛
conditions.summary: Neck and shoulder strain from desk work eases first with breaks every hour or two, forearm support and neck exercise; classical acupressure adds GB20, GB21 and LI11 as an optional comfort pause, on limited evidence.

conditions.name: 术后及化疗恶心
conditions.summary: For nausea after surgery or chemotherapy, classical acupressure reaches first for PC6 (Neiguan) on the inner wrist, with LI4 and ST36 as companions — always as an add-on to prescribed anti-sickness medicine, never a replacement.

conditions.name: 腹胀
conditions.summary: For a bloated, distended belly, Chinese nursing care pairs clockwise belly massage with CV12, ST25 and CV6 on the abdomen and ST36 and PC6 on the leg and wrist; skip CV6 in pregnancy.

conditions.name: 便秘
conditions.summary: For ordinary constipation, habits come first; classical acupressure adds a clockwise belly massage and the points ST25, TH6, ST36, and ST37.

conditions.name: 膝关节痛
conditions.summary: For knee osteoarthritis pain, exercise and weight management come first; classical acupressure adds six points ringing the knee: SP10, ST34, ST35, SP9, GB34 and ST36.

conditions.name: 中风后
conditions.summary: After a stroke, a national Chinese nursing protocol names GB21, LI11, TH5 and LI4 on the arm and GB34, BL40 and GB39 on the leg; a carer presses them lightly on the weak side, alongside rehabilitation, never on spastic muscle or a swollen limb.

conditions.name: 疲倦乏力
conditions.summary: For everyday tiredness of the depleted kind, Chinese medicine reaches for ST36 (Zusanli), SP6, CV6 and CV4 below the navel, and LI4; research on hand-pressed points comes mainly from fatigue after cancer treatment and in haemodialysis.

conditions.name: 分娩痛
conditions.summary: Sanyinjiao (SP6) and hegu (LI4), pressed by a birth partner through contractions, only once labour has started at 37 weeks or later and only with the midwife's or obstetric team's agreement; never to start labour or before term.
